NAME:
   rancher create project - Create a project in a cluster

USAGE:
   rancher create project [options] [id]

OPTIONS:
   --cluster id|name                             target cluster id|name
   --container-default-resource-limit key=value  default container resource requests and limits as key=value pairs
   --description description                     short description for the project
   --display-name name                           display name of the project (default: the id; required when no id is given)
   --help, -h                                    show help
   --namespace-default-quota key=value           default resource quota for each namespace as key=value pairs (same keys as --quota-limit)
   --quota-limit key=value                       project resource quota limit as key=value pairs, e.g. limitsCpu=2,limitsMemory=4Gi

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
